name: Cabo Verde (IRPS)

validation.referee: statute's own printed tables and amounts (Lean decide)
validation.notes: build phase: no referee values used; cases = Lean theorems (kernel instances and checks of the statute's printed tables and stated amounts, all proved)

reused_from: PT (IRS structure: categories, englobamento, quociente conjugal)
sources: Código do IRPS, Lei n.º 78/VIII/2014 (B.O. I Série n.º 81, 31.12.2014) and its republication by Lei n.º 116/IX/2021 de 2 de fevereiro (B.O. I Série n.º 10), DNRE library https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/legislacao
Orçamento do Estado 2025 (B.O. I Série n.º 125 Sup., 30.12.2024), DNRE library: no IRPS amendment
scale: 1800000 CVE (threshold of the top (27,5 %) IRPS rate)
registry_correction: CV: IRPS (Lei 78/VIII/2014, republished by Lei 116/IX/2021) confirmed; access B.
headline: Cabo Verde built from the IRPS code as republished in 2021 (OE 2025 checked): englobamento at 16,5/23,1/27,5 % after a 220 000 CVE mínimo per taxpayer, married splitting (quociente conjugal), 5 000 CVE per dependant; liberatory 20 % on capital income and 10 % on property income. The rate article can also be read as a whole-income step tariff with a 63 360 CVE notch.
